issue_request: FHIR-5472 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 OO ballot comment reporting that the DiagnosticReport section's third-bullet link to the micro sensitivities example produced an error page at diagnosticreport-micro1.html; the accepted disposition was to fix the example publishing issue and close it.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly names FHIR-5472. Jira comments state the publishing issue with examples was known and would be closed. Git history shows the micro example existed before the tracker and was maintained in later DiagnosticReport/Observation example migrations, including d6259fa8e3 on 2015-02-17.
additional_context: DiagnosticReport remains active in source/fhir.ini, and diagnosticreport-micro1 is still listed and linked from current DiagnosticReport and Observation guidance. Later same-area decisions retained or referenced the example: FHIR-9038 ended as Resolved - No Change, FHIR-29823 points AMR readers to the current micro example, and FHIR-40540 updated surrounding Diagnostic Module guidance without removing the link.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source has a well-formed source/diagnosticreport/diagnosticreport-micro1.xml, an active DiagnosticReport example-list entry, and current build pages for both diagnosticreport-micro1.html and diagnosticreport-micro1.xml.html returning HTTP 200.
